acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:1cb820a3-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As the Director of Communications at Vanta you’ll be part of a growing Communications & Content team responsible for telling Vanta’s company story across external and internal audiences,including media, influencers and 3rd party validators, customers, prospects and partners. The Director of Communications will lead and drive our integrated communications program, increasing awareness of Vanta and our market leadership across external and internal audiences. This role is a critical member of our team focused on amplifying Vanta’s brand and market vision, driving both enterprise and start-up credibility and illustrating the value we deliver for global customers across traditional and new media audiences. The ideal candidate is a hands-on communications pro with a passion for crafting compelling corporate narratives, developing close relationships with key industry influencers, and working across teams to drive results. We're looking for a critical thinker with strong writing and communication skills, deep AI/B2B/SaaS/Security product knowledge, a wide network of relationships across traditional and new media, excitement to experiment with AI and a passion for pioneering the future of trust. What you’ll do as a Director of Communications at Vanta: - Drive the execution of our external communications strategy in partnership with internal stakeholders including product and growth marketing, content, analyst relations and leadership teams. - Work closely with external PR agency partners to craft and execute our communications strategy focusing on global top-tier business, tech, and security media across traditional and new (media (Substack, podcasts, influencers). - Grow and diversify our thought-leadership around topics of AI, security, trust in an agentic world, and the future of automation and uncover new channels to increase Vanta brand awareness. - Integrate our first party data storytelling program (Trust Signals) into executive thought leadership, external messaging, and earned media coverage. - Partner cross functionally on external events and brand marketing opportunities to amplify Vanta’s leadership in Agentic Trust Develop and execute internal communications moments including monthly All Hands; internal newsletter for cross-company alignment; and more. - Partner with Operations, Marketing and Leadership teams on a variety of operational efficiency initiatives aimed at improving how we work and communicate as a fast-growing global organization. - Use AI with strong judgment and taste to scale our efforts and increase impact. How to be successful in this role: - 10-12+ years of experience in Communications either in-house, agency or a combination of both - You have deep new and traditional media relationships, strong writing skills, a finger on the pulse of AI/B2B/Security trends, and excitement to experiment with AI. - You’re an all-around Comms rockstar with a passion for both external and internal communications initiatives. - You're a self-starter who loves working across different teams in the company to drive alignment and clarity. - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. assistworld-assist-world:lever:a36ed3a0-.description: About the Company A specialized company that installs automated racking and robotic storage systems for warehouses and industrial facilities. These high-tech systems include automated forklifts and advanced storage solutions used in large-scale logistics environments. As the company expands and takes on larger installation projects, including international work we are seeking a reliable Virtual Assistant to help manage administrative coordination, equipment logistics, and project tracking. Role Overview This role is primarily administrative and operational support for the company owner. You will help coordinate project logistics, maintain organized records of quotes and job progress, and assist with travel and equipment arrangements for installation projects. The role will begin part-time and may scale to full-time as project volume increases. Core Responsibilities Administrative & Project Support ● Maintain a job log to track ongoing installation projects ● Maintain and update a quote tracking log ● Organize project documentation and notes ● Assist the owner with administrative coordination and task tracking Travel & Logistics Coordination ● Book hotel accommodations for installation teams ● Assist with scheduling travel for project work ● Coordinate project-related logistics as needed Equipment Rental Coordination ● Contact suppliers to arrange rental equipment for installation projects ● Confirm availability and delivery timelines ● Maintain records of equipment rentals and related costs Communication & Internal Coordination ● Work directly with the company owner to organize project activities ● Communicate occasionally with suppliers when equipment rentals are needed ● Maintain clear records and updates on project progress Most communication will be internal with the owner rather than customer-facing. Required Qualifications ● Fluent English and Spanish (spoken and written) ● Strong organizational and administrative skills ● Experience using Microsoft Excel and Word ● Ability to track and manage multiple projects ● Comfortable coordinating logistics and supplier communication ● Strong attention to detail ● Reliable and proactive work ethic Preferred Qualifications ● Based in Latin America (Colombia preferred) ● Experience supporting construction, logistics, or operations teams ● Experience coordinating travel or equipment logistics ● Familiarity with project tracking or job logs Working Style The ideal candidate is: ● Organized and dependable ● Comfortable working independently ● Detail-oriented with strong follow-through ● Able to maintain structured logs and documentation This role supports a hands-on, operations-focused business, so practicality and reliability are highly valued. Schedule & Growth ● Start: Part-Time (20 hours per week) ● Potential to expand to Full-Time as project workload grows ● Must be able to work within Eastern Time business hours

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: COMPANY DESCRIPTION Abiologics, Inc. is a privately held, early-stage biotechnology company on a mission to make biology better through an innovative therapeutic modality. We are pioneering the development of Synteins™, a transformational class of macromolecular medicines unlocked by novel synthetic and computational technologies. Abiologics is actively seeking exceptional scientists who are passionate about driving therapeutic modality innovation in biotechnology. Abiologics was founded in Flagship Pioneering’s venture creation engine, where companies such as Moderna Therapeutics (NASDAQ: MRNA) and Generate Biomedicines were conceived and created. Since Flagship’s founding in 2000, the firm has originated and fostered the development of more than 100 scientific ventures resulting in more than 500 issued patents and more than 50 clinical trials for novel therapeutic agents. THE ROLE We are looking for a highly motivated, broadly skilled cell biologist and assay developer to join our growing Pharmacology team. In this role, the successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing biochemical and cell-based assays to support the progression of Abiologics’ pipeline. Occasionally, this individual may contribute to in vivo and ex-vivo pharmacology activities to progress projects and the platform. In addition, this role will collaborate cross-functionally with a diverse design-make-test team across Abiologics and have the opportunity to impact platform and company growth. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design and execute cell-based and biochemical assays to assess Syntein TM activity, target engagement, and mechanism of action to drive discovery programs With guidance from manager, conceptualize and develop novel assays for diverse target classes and disease areas Collaborate with the Pharmacology team on biochemistry and biophysics projects and provide cell biology expertise Contribute to in vivo and ex vivo pharmacology activities to progress projects and the platform Collaborate cross-functionally to enable novel methods, assays and screening workflows, including optimization of assays for incorporation into screening funnels and cross-training of colleagues on methods Ensure rapid generation and accurate reporting of high-quality data and collaborate with Computational Design and Chemistry & Screening teams to drive design-make-test cycles Effectively communicate scientific findings and ideas to a diverse team both informally and at project team meetings PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS PhD in molecular or cell biology or related discipline with up to 2 years relevant experience; industry experience is preferred Technical expertise with mammalian cell culture including establishing and maintaining cell lines, transient and stable transfection, lentiviral transduction, and reporter cell lines Proficient in industry-standard cell-based assays and bioanalytical techniques including TR-FRET, Lumit, ELISA, Western blot, flow cytometry, enzymatic activity, and reporter gene assays; experience with cellular/high content imaging and image analysis a plus (e.g., Incucyte, Phenix) Experienced with primary cell culture and characterization, including tissue dissociation Experienced in assay development and testing in model systems and human with good understanding of analytical and pre-analytical methods and solutions Demonstrated ability to independently design, develop and optimize diverse cell-based functional assays (e.g., intracellular signaling) and interpret complex results Strong proficiency in renal disease biology and preclinical kidney models is highly desirable In vivo pharmacology experience would be a plus Proficiency in laboratory automation and semi-automated screening workflows is a plus Industry level experience with best practices related to data records creation and maintenance and workflow integrity Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment; We value high-impact talent, continuous learning, experimentation, and people who see AI as a teammate that helps them move faster and deliver meaningful results. This role follows a hybrid model with 3 days per week in the New York office. We are hiring a Public Relations Manager to join Gen’s Trust Services business within the Global Marketing, Brand and Communications organization. The role primarily supports LifeLock, the leading identity theft protection brand in the U.S., while also contributing to the broader consumer portfolio, including MoneyLion and Reputation Defender. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you will own LifeLock communications end to end, drive rapid response and newsjacking opportunities across brands, and help bring influencer partnerships to life. This is an opportunity to shape visibility, trust, and relevance for one of Gen’s most recognized consumer brands. Base salary is one component of Gen's total compensation package, which includes 401(k) match, health insurance options, disability coverage, life insurance, and unlimited paid time off. Actual salaries will vary based on a candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and competencies related to the role. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6f2bd21d-3de4-.title: Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand
jobgether-jobgether:lever:6f2bd21d-3de4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in Ireland. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Success means building an organization that runs efficiently, solves problems proactively, and no longer depends on you for daily execution. Own end-to-end back-end operations, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing relationships, 3PL and fulfillment, returns, vendor management, and agency coordination. Build and maintain scalable operating systems, processes, and SOPs, ensuring every recurring workflow has clear ownership, documentation, measurement, and accountability. Establish and maintain an operational knowledge base in Notion, continuously improving processes as the business grows and new needs emerge. Develop accurate inventory systems of record, purchase-order calendars, and processes that improve inventory visibility, planning, and stock availability. Build reliable reporting and a single source of truth for weekly leadership metrics, including inventory, stockouts, cost per order, channel and subscription revenue, vendor performance, and other operational KPIs. Create automated subscription and channel revenue reporting and develop a concise weekly operations scorecard for leadership decision-making. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Identify missing organizational functions, define roles and scorecards, lead recruitment, conduct screening, onboard new hires, and develop functional owners. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. Requirements At least 3 years of operations experience within a physical-product, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer business. Experience operating within a high-growth environment, ideally supporting or helping scale a brand generating approximately $20M–$50M in annual revenue. southparkcommons-rox-ai:ashbyhq:64036885.title: Strategic Finance Lead
southparkcommons-rox-ai:ashbyhq:64036885.description: ABOUT ROX Rox is building the AI-native revenue operating system for modern go-to-market teams. Backed by Sequoia, GV, and General Catalyst, we replace fragmented CRM workflows with intelligent, autonomous systems that drive real outcomes. We are a Series A company, about 150 people, working at the intersection of data, AI, and revenue execution. Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents that take on the manual work, so people can focus on what they do best: selling. The same way coding agents 10x'd engineering, revenue agents are 10x'ing customer work. We are building the world's first revenue operating system, from the application layer down to the system of context underneath it. Humans move into the orchestrator seat, agents run the end to end customer lifecycle. THE ROLE This is the first dedicated Strategic Finance hire at Rox, reporting to the Head of Finance. You will own the company operating model and be the analytical partner to the exec team on the decisions that move the business: how fast we hire, what we charge, which segments we lean into, and where margin comes from. Finance at Rox is an operating partner to Engineering, Product, and GTM, not a back-office function. The team is lean, builds most of its own tooling, and owns both revenue truth and margin truth. This is a lean unit with an outsized mission. The pace is high, the hours are long, and the surface area is wider than the headcount, which means real ownership, short turnarounds, and very little cover. You take the hard problems first, come back with a number that holds, and defend it in front of the exec team and the board. The scope grows with the company, and so does the opportunity to build a team around the function. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - The operating model: revenue, headcount, opex, margin, cash, and runway. The annual plan and the rolling reforecast, built so the exec team actually uses it - The FP&A cadence: monthly forecast versus actuals across every department, variances explained in plain English, hiring and spend tradeoffs owned alongside budget owners - Revenue truth: ARR, CARR, bookings, retention, and expansion defined once and used everywhere. Contracted, billed, and recognized revenue reconciled, with every delta explainable - GTM finance: sales capacity and quota coverage, ramp and productivity by segment, pipeline analysis, and what the GTM plan implies for the P&L - Unit economics and gross margin: margin by customer, segment, and product, including the AI and cloud COGS underneath it. CAC, payback, and LTV computed honestly, plus an efficiency pipeline with Engineering where margin is the constraint WHAT YOU'LL SUPPORT - Pricing and packaging: the economics behind tier and pricing changes, discounting behavior, and the self-serve versus enterprise motion, so Product and GTM can decide with the tradeoffs quantified - Board and investor materials: the board model and metrics package, plus clean, defensible numbers for fundraising and diligence WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in strategic finance, FP&A, investment banking, private equity, growth equity, or consulting, with real ownership of an operating model - High-growth B2B SaaS experience required, ideally including building something from scratch rather than inheriting a mature process - Fluency in SaaS metrics: ARR, NDR, cohort retention, CAC payback, sales capacity and ramp. You should have opinions about how these get computed wrong - Expert-level in spreadsheets, comfortable with large, messy datasets - Concise, decision-ready writing that quantifies tradeoffs and makes accountability explicit - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building - Based in the Bay Area, or willing to relocate, and in the San Francisco office five days a week BONUS POINTS - Experience supporting a fundraise, board process, or diligence workstream - Pricing and packaging work, especially across a self-serve and enterprise motion - Working knowledge of AI and cloud cost dr

strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:79049.title: Production Line Lead - 3rd Shift
strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:79049.description: Job Opportunity: Production Line Lead - 3rd Shift with Ditsch USA in Cincinnati, OH Ready to take the next step in your manufacturing career? Looking for a 3rd shift leadership role where you can support a team, keep production moving, and make a real impact? If you enjoy solving problems, leading by example, and working in a fast-paced environment, this could be a great opportunity! Ditsch USA is looking for a Production Line Lead to join our Cincinnati team on 3rd shift . In this role, you will help lead production, support your team, and keep operations running safely and efficiently. If you are a hands-on leader who enjoys a fast-paced manufacturing environment, this could be a strong next step. Pay range: $21.50-23.50/hour. Why Join Ditsch USA? Competitive pay ($21.50 - $23.50/hour) 3rd shift schedule (10:00 PM - 6:00 AM) Medical, dental, and vision insurance Free $25,000 life insurance 401(k) with company match PTO and paid holidays Ongoing training and career development About the Role As a Line Lead, you will help keep the production line running smoothly while supporting your team and maintaining high standards for safety and quality. In this role, you will: Maintain a clean and safe work environment and enforce safety standards. Lead, coach, and support team members on the production floor. Monitor production schedules and ensure efficient line operations. Coordinate shift changes, staffing, and workflow. Troubleshoot issues and help resolve production challenges. Ensure compliance with food safety and manufacturing standards. Complete production documentation and communicate updates to leadership. Support training and development of team members. Assist with continuous improvement initiatives. What You Bring We are looking for someone who is dependable, motivated, and comfortable leading by example on the production floor. To be successful in this role, you should have: High school diploma or equivalent 2+ years of manufacturing experience, preferably in food production Prior leadership or team lead experience preferred. Strong critical thinking skills and mechanical aptitude Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-focused environment. Clear communication skills and attention to detail Basic math skills and flexibility to work weekends as needed. Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. Stand and move throughout your shift for 8+ hours. Ability to work in varying temperatures, from freezer areas to the production floor. If you are ready for a leadership opportunity where you can make an impact, support a team, and grow your manufacturing career, we would love to hear from you. Apply online today. Se habla español – Spanish-speaking candidates are welcome to apply. #ZR

The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members.
